findings.title: Sequence consistent with guessing then use of authenticated session
findings.explanation: Repeated failures followed by success and restricted export is consistent with password attempts followed by use of authenticated session, but operator identity, intent and credential source are not recorded.
findings.limitations: Unproven; benign password retries by legitimate user not excluded.

findings.title: Legitimate retry and authorized export not excluded
findings.explanation: Application permission check accepted access, which could reflect legitimate user retries then authorized export. No entitlement or approval record was retrieved to decide.
findings.limitations: No role, ticket or baseline reviewed.

findings.title: Authorization and MFA status undetermined
findings.explanation: The model proposed a quantitative interpretation that has not been accepted as a verified claim. Review the cited events and computed query receipts.
findings.limitations: Requires IAM, ticketing and device evidence not in current results.
